title: OBR less vegetation
description: Openworld BattleRoyale datapack: Reduced overworld vegetation
body:
This data pack is custom-made for Openworld BattleRoyale modpack.

## Key Modifications
- Only modifies biomes found in the **Overworld**.
- Significantly reduces the generation of vegetation such as **trees** and **grass** in the Overworld.
- Slightly alters the spawning rates of flowers and melons/pumpkins.

The modified vanilla biomes are broadly categorized into three types based on their intended design:

### Open Plains Zones
Cover is scarce and clearly defined, making it difficult to reposition once combat begins.

- Key Characteristics: Sparse trees, very little tall grass.
- Typical Biomes: Plains, Desert.

> A camper's nightmare.

### Woodland Zones
The amount of vegetation in these areas doesn't hinder visibility of enemy movements; trees primarily serve as cover during engagements.

- Key Characteristics: Moderate tree density, may include tall grass.
- Typical Biomes: Birch Forest, Cherry Grove, Dark Forest, Savanna.

> Beware of third-party interference.

### Dense Jungle Zones
These areas allow for quick concealment to evade pursuit, but also leave players vulnerable to hidden ambushes from all directions.

- Key Characteristics: Denser trees, contains numerous readily available hiding spots.
- Typical Biomes: Jungle.

> You'll struggle in vain against the auto-firing foliage.
